    Homogeneous morphisms for a shift orbit category #

    Mathlib's HasShift is a coherent action of an additive monoid by endofunctors. For a group action written additively, the homogeneous degree-a orbit morphisms from X to Y are the morphisms X ⟶ Y⟦a⟧. This file defines their identity and composition and proves the unit and associativity laws before passing to direct sums.
